# Downloadable datasets

- **`postcode_to_wrz_master.csv.zip`** - every live England & Wales postcode
  (1,587,255 rows) matched to its Water Resource Zone. See the main
  [README](../README.md#output-columns) for column definitions.
- **`wrz_boundaries.geojson.zip`** - the 129 zone boundaries used for the
  join (MOSL's 128 zones + the EA's Isles of Scilly zone, which MOSL omits),
  full precision, EPSG:4326.

Both are also available as one-click downloads from the
[WRZ Finder tool](https://claude.ai/artifact/Evq6G3SrL2uR47DJApAesn) itself.
